changes.title: Chart moon
items: On the map table the moon rises over the north-west edge as it opens, then circles slowly, and every island casts its shadow across the sea
The map table has open sea round its edge

changes.title: Rune pull any side
items: A happy creature near you brings its sigil to your feet from any side, walking round you and your animals

changes.title: Hologram bend
items: The soundsystems' sky sigils no longer show through the ground past the horizon

changes.title: Happy rune south
items: A happy creature carries its sigil a little to the south of it, the same distance a parked creature rests from its placed sigil; pick it up there
A happy creature's rune shows through grass, bushes and trees, as a placed sigil does

changes.title: Beach decor half
items: Half as many shells, pebbles, seaweed and footprint trails on the beach

changes.title: Temple variants
items: The temple ruins come in many more shapes, different on every island: a round temple, a long colonnade, a temple on its podium, a fallen pediment, a portico half buried in a mound, an overgrown theatre
Small classical ruins scatter more widely: a few columns, a lone column, a doorway, an altar on its steps

changes.title: Trunk shadow controls
items: The pause page has every trunk-shadow control: style (soft, hard, off), core, width and a campfire's reach, beside darkness, length and your glow's reach and height
